intro.text: This entry describes ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD), a disorder of cornification combining generalized scaling with erythematous, hyperkeratotic plaques. I cannot reliably recall the causative gene or the primary reports, so they are not stated here.

checks.claim: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) is a disorder of cornification.
checks.evidence_quote: variants at Gly50 affecting the SP cleavage of KLK11 cause a new autosomal-dominant cornification disorder with abnormal desquamation
checks.explanation: The paper describes a new cornification disorder with erythrokeratoderma, but it never uses the name 'ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD)'.

checks.claim: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) combines generalized scaling with erythematous, hyperkeratotic plaques.
checks.evidence_quote: which is characterized by early-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma
checks.explanation: The abstract names ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma, but it does not mention generalized scaling combined with erythematous hyperkeratotic plaques.

paragraphs.text: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) is a disorder of keratinization. It is characterized by generalized ichthyotic scaling together with well-demarcated erythematous hyperkeratotic plaques of the erythrokeratoderma type. Palmoplantar keratoderma may also be present. The specific genetic basis and the primary case reports are not reproduced here because they cannot be recalled with confidence.

checks.claim: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) is a disorder of keratinization.
checks.evidence_quote: Our findings highlight the essential role of KLKs in maintaining homeostasis of skin keratinization and desquamation.
checks.explanation: The paper calls it a cornification disorder and refers to keratinization, but it does not use the name IEKD.

checks.claim: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) is characterized by generalized ichthyotic scaling.
checks.evidence_quote: which is characterized by early-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma
checks.explanation: The abstract mentions ichthyosiform erythroderma. It does not specifically say 'generalized ichthyotic scaling'.

checks.claim: Ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD) is characterized by well-demarcated erythematous hyperkeratotic plaques of the erythrokeratoderma type.
checks.evidence_quote: which is characterized by early-onset ichthyosiform erythroderma or erythrokeratoderma
checks.explanation: The abstract mentions erythrokeratoderma, but it does not describe well-demarcated erythematous hyperkeratotic plaques. It also presents erythroderma and erythrokeratoderma as alternatives ('or').

checks.claim: Palmoplantar keratoderma may be present in ichthyosis with erythrokeratoderma (IEKD).
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 2 cited papers. The abstract does not mention palmoplantar keratoderma. Only the abstract was supplied, so the full text could not be checked.
